final saved = <int>[];
Future<void> save(int index) async {
  saved.add(index);
}

Future<void> main() async {
  final rows = [for (var index = 0; index < 4; await save(index), index++) index];
  if (saved.join(',') != '0,1,2,3' || rows.length != 4) throw StateError('$saved');
  print('saved=$saved, rows=$rows');
}
